name: PyDynamicForest
description: Python research code for forest stand dynamics described by a tree density structured by height and diameter at breast height (DBH), with a non-local size hierarchy. Version 1.0.0 produces the numerical results of the article 'A well-posed height–diameter population model of forest stand dynamics with a non-local size hierarchy' (pipeline studies/ecouves_a5).
funding: Interdisciplinary programme ARTEMIS of Lorraine Université d'Excellence (ANR-15-IDEX-04-LUE)
